title: 缓冲溶液、pH计与原电池
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/175_缓冲溶液、pH计与原电池.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/175_缓冲溶液、pH计与原电池/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在pH计和几杯溶液旁，手拿一支电极
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a benchtop pH meter and a few beakers of clear solution, holding a glass pH electrode carefully, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第15章第十三课：缓冲溶液、pH计与原电池。

shots.scene: 阿杰把干放了一周的电极直接插进溶液
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pulls a dry pH electrode out of a drawer and plunges it straight into a beaker, the meter number jumping around, a red warning icon.
shots.narration: 阿杰拿起干放一周的电极就测。

shots.scene: 电极撞上杯底的搅拌子
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fragile glass electrode bulb hitting a spinning stir bar at the bottom of a beaker, a crack icon, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 电极还撞上了转动的搅拌子。

shots.scene: 小研拦住他：先校准，护好电极
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wearing safety goggles stops the young male student and points to a small bottle of storage solution and calibration buffers.
shots.narration: 小研：没校准、没保护，读数不可信。

shots.scene: 清水和缓冲液各滴几滴强酸
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two beakers, plain water and a buffer, each receiving a few drops of acid from a dropper, two pH gauges beside them. No text.
shots.narration: 同样滴几滴强酸，比一比。

shots.scene: 清水pH大跌，缓冲液几乎不变
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the gauge for water dropping sharply while the gauge for the buffer stays nearly steady, a shield icon on the buffer. No text.
shots.narration: 清水pH大跌，缓冲液基本不变。

shots.scene: 弱酸和共轭碱一起中和酸碱
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a weak acid molecule and its conjugate base pair catching incoming acid and base particles. No text.
shots.narration: 靠弱酸和共轭碱，吸收加入的酸碱。

shots.scene: 浓度越高，缓冲容量越大
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small shield and a big shield, the bigger shield labeled by more molecules, a capacity bar rising. No text.
shots.narration: 能扛多少酸碱叫缓冲容量，浓度越高越大。

shots.scene: 先定目标pH，再查pKa表
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a target pH mark on a scale and a table of weak acids with their values, a magnifier on the table. No text.
shots.narration: 先定目标pH，再查弱酸的pKa表。

shots.scene: pKa在目标pH上下一个单位内
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pH scale with a highlighted window one unit on each side of the target, a closest candidate checked. No text.
shots.narration: pKa在目标上下一个单位内，越近越好。

shots.scene: 例：目标7.3，选磷酸二氢根
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a target of seven point three, a candidate at six point eight checked, two phosphate salt bottles with blank labels. No text.
shots.narration: 例：目标7.3，选pKa 6.82的磷酸体系。

shots.scene: 缓冲液也会结合金属、见光生自由基
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a buffer molecule grabbing a metal ion and another giving off a radical under a lamp, a caution icon. No text.
shots.narration: 有的缓冲液结合金属、见光生自由基。

shots.scene: 按实验体系选不干扰的缓冲液
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a checklist with a protein icon, a metal ion icon and a light icon, one compatible buffer bottle checked. No text.
shots.narration: 按实验选不干扰反应的缓冲液。

shots.scene: 亨德森—哈塞尔巴尔赫方程
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a simple balance with a conjugate base on one side and a weak acid on the other, a ratio arrow between them. No text.
shots.narration: 用亨德森方程，算出碱和酸的比例。

shots.scene: 比例约1.6，总量50毫摩尔
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two stacks in a ratio of about one point six to one, adding up to a total concentration bar. No text.
shots.narration: 碱酸比约1.6，两者加起来50毫摩尔。

shots.scene: 算出各自质量，分别称量
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two weighing boats on a balance with small piles of white salt, a calculator icon beside. No text.
shots.narration: 算出各自质量，分别称量。

shots.scene: 溶解定容后，用pH计核对
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the dissolved solution in a flask topped up to the mark, then checked with a pH electrode. No text.
shots.narration: 溶解定容，最后用pH计核对。

shots.scene: 方法二：先加约八成的水和搅拌子
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a large beaker filled about four fifths with water and a stir bar on a magnetic stirrer. No text.
shots.narration: 方法二更简单：先加八成水和搅拌子。

shots.scene: 称好弱碱倒入，冲洗称量舟
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a weighed portion of white powder poured from a weighing boat into the beaker, the boat rinsed into the beaker with a wash bottle. No text.
shots.narration: 称好的试剂倒入，称量舟也冲洗进去。

shots.scene: 调节液先看标签：强酸强碱腐蚀
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small bottle of dilute acid with a corrosive pictogram and a safety data sheet, safety goggles and gloves. No text.
shots.narration: 调节用的酸碱有腐蚀性，先看标签。

shots.scene: 边搅拌边监测，逐滴加入
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wearing safety goggles and gloves adds acid drop by drop with a dropper while watching the pH meter, the electrode held away from the stir bar.
shots.narration: 边搅拌边看读数，少量多次逐滴加。

shots.scene: 调节液太稀太浓都不好
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a very dilute bottle needing a huge volume and a very concentrated bottle overshooting with one drop, both crossed out, a medium bottle checked. No text.
shots.narration: 太稀冲淡缓冲液，太浓一滴就过头。

shots.scene: 调过头再往回调，盐会变多
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a needle overshooting the target and coming back, extra salt crystals accumulating, a warning icon. No text.
shots.narration: 调过头再调回，溶液里盐就多了。

shots.scene: 转入容量瓶，洗烧杯并入
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the solution poured into a volumetric flask through a funnel, the beaker rinsed several times into the flask. No text.
shots.narration: 转入容量瓶，烧杯洗几次并入。

shots.scene: 定容到刻度，视线平齐
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an eye level with the graduation mark on the flask neck as water is added to the mark. No text.
shots.narration: 加水到刻度，视线与刻度平齐。

shots.scene: 盖紧瓶塞，反复颠倒混匀
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a stoppered volumetric flask held with a hand on the stopper and turned upside down several times. No text.
shots.narration: 盖紧瓶塞，反复颠倒混匀。

shots.scene: pH计：显示屏、电极、尖端球泡
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a generic benchtop pH meter with a display, a combination electrode on an arm and a thin glass bulb at the tip highlighted, no logos. No text.
shots.narration: pH计：显示屏、电极和尖端球泡。

shots.scene: 玻璃电极外套着参比电极
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cutaway combination electrode showing an inner glass electrode and an outer reference chamber around it. No text.
shots.narration: 玻璃电极外面，套着参比电极。

shots.scene: 内外pH不同产生电位差
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: hydrogen ions on both sides of a thin glass membrane, a small voltage arrow across it, a meter reading. No text.
shots.narration: 膜内外pH不同，产生电位差。

shots.scene: 第一次用：先培训、看规程、登记
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator shows the young male student an operating procedure sheet and a usage log beside the pH meter.
shots.narration: 第一次用先培训，看规程，用后登记。

shots.scene: 球泡是很薄的玻璃
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a magnified thin glass bulb at the electrode tip with a fragile icon. No text.
shots.narration: 尖端球泡是很薄的玻璃，易碎。

shots.scene: 别碰杯壁，远离搅拌子
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an electrode held in the middle of a beaker away from the wall and from the stir bar, touching the wall crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 别碰杯壁，离搅拌子远一点。

shots.scene: 轻放轻取，不甩不对人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an electrode lowered gently into a beaker, and a hand flinging an electrode in the air crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 轻放轻取，不在空中甩。

shots.scene: 破了用镊子收进碎玻璃盒
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a broken electrode tip picked up with tweezers into a broken glass box, a bare hand crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 破了别徒手捡，放进碎玻璃盒。

shots.scene: 先接好电极，再校准
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an electrode cable connected to the meter, then a calibration icon with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 先确认电极接好，再校准。

shots.scene: 开机要校准，用久了复校
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a power icon followed by calibration, and a clock showing several hours followed by calibration again. No text.
shots.narration: 每次开机校准，连续用几小时复校。

shots.scene: 三种常用标准缓冲液
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three small bottles of standard buffer solutions with blank labels in different pastel colors. No text.
shots.narration: 常用标准缓冲液有三种。

shots.scene: 选和样品最接近的两种
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an acidic sample matched with the neutral and acidic standards, an alkaline sample matched with the neutral and alkaline standards. No text.
shots.narration: 两点校准：选和样品最接近的两种。

shots.scene: 【实拍】蒸馏水冲洗电极，接进废液杯
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a wash bottle rinsing a pH electrode tip with distilled water over a small waste beaker.
shots.narration: 蒸馏水冲洗电极，冲洗水接进废液杯。

shots.scene: 【实拍】无尘纸轻轻吸干
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a lint-free tissue gently dabbing the electrode bulb dry without rubbing.
shots.narration: 无尘纸轻轻吸干，别用力擦。

shots.scene: 【实拍】倒少量标准液到小杯
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a small amount of standard buffer poured from its bottle into a small clean cup, the bottle closed right away.
shots.narration: 倒一点标准液到小杯，别污染整瓶。

shots.scene: 【实拍】插入第一种标准液，按校准
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the electrode lowered into the small cup of standard buffer so the bulb is fully covered, a finger pressing a calibration key.
shots.narration: 插入第一种标准液，按校准键。

shots.scene: 读数稳定后确认
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a display reading settling to a steady value, a confirm key pressed. No text.
shots.narration: 读数稳定后，按确认。

shots.scene: 冲洗吸干，测第二种
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: rinse, blot and dip into the second standard cup, a steady reading confirmed. No text.
shots.narration: 冲洗吸干，换第二种，同样确认。

shots.scene: 用过的标准液不倒回原瓶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: used buffer in the small cup poured back into the stock bottle crossed out, poured into a waste beaker checked. No text.
shots.narration: 用过的标准液，不倒回原瓶。

shots.scene: 样品温度与校准温度一致
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thermometer icon on the sample and on the standard showing the same temperature, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: pH随温度变，样品温度要一致。

shots.scene: 冲洗吸干，球泡完全浸没
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rinsed and blotted electrode lowered so the whole bulb is under the sample surface, the fill hole open. No text.
shots.narration: 冲洗吸干，球泡完全浸没。

shots.scene: 搅匀后等读数稳定再记
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the solution stirred gently, the display flickering and then holding steady, a notebook entry. No text.
shots.narration: 搅匀，等读数稳定再记录。

shots.scene: 配得准测得准，样品才稳定
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an accurate buffer bottle and an accurate meter leading to a happy protein icon staying active over time. No text.
shots.narration: 配得准测得准，蛋白才能长期稳定。

shots.scene: 电极平时泡在保存液里
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pH electrode stored upright in a small storage bottle with the bulb fully covered by storage solution. No text.
shots.narration: 电极平时泡在保存液里。

shots.scene: 干放失灵，泡纯水也不行
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dry electrode in a drawer and an electrode soaking in a beaker of pure water, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 干放会失灵，长期泡纯水也不行。

shots.scene: 【实拍】慢慢抽出电极
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a hand loosening the cap of a storage bottle and slowly drawing the electrode out.
shots.narration: 先拧松瓶盖，慢慢抽出，别形成负压。

shots.scene: 定期换保存液，没过球泡
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: old storage solution poured into a waste beaker, the bottle rinsed, fresh solution filled above the bulb level. No text.
shots.narration: 定期换保存液，加到没过球泡。

shots.scene: 【实拍】电极滑回保存瓶，拧紧盖
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the cap slipped loosely over the electrode, the electrode slid gently into the storage bottle, then the cap tightened.
shots.narration: 瓶盖先套上，电极滑进去再拧紧。

shots.scene: 换液前穿戴防护，铺吸水垫
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a lab coat, safety goggles and gloves lays an absorbent pad on the bench with a waste beaker ready.
shots.narration: 维护前戴好护目镜手套，铺好吸水垫。

shots.scene: 【实拍】从加液孔补满内充液
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the nozzle of a filling solution bottle inserted into the side fill hole of a refillable electrode, filling it up.
shots.narration: 用规定的内充液，从加液孔补满。

shots.scene: 内液面高于样品液面
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cutaway electrode in a beaker, the inner liquid level clearly higher than the sample level, a small outward flow arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 内液面高于样品，样品就不倒灌。

shots.scene: 快流式每天补，旧液排进废液杯
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: old filling solution drained or drawn out with a dropper into a waste beaker, then refilled, a daily calendar icon. No text.
shots.narration: 旧液排进废液杯，每天用前补满。

shots.scene: 测时打开加液孔，存放时盖上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the fill hole open during measurement and covered during overnight storage, two small panels. No text.
shots.narration: 测量时打开加液孔，过夜存放盖上。

shots.scene: 冲净外壁，贴签登记
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the outside of the electrode rinsed with deionized water, bottles labeled with name and date, a maintenance log. No text.
shots.narration: 冲净外壁，瓶子贴签，维护登记。

shots.scene: 电池把化学能变成电能
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a chemical flask icon turning into a lightning bolt icon through a simple battery. No text.
shots.narration: 电池把化学能变成电能：电化学。

shots.scene: 自发的氧化还原反应
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one atom losing electrons marked as oxidation and another gaining electrons marked as reduction. No text.
shots.narration: 失电子是氧化，得电子是还原。

shots.scene: 电子流动像流水推水车
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: flowing water turning a water wheel beside electrons flowing along a wire lighting a small bulb. No text.
shots.narration: 电子流动像流水，能推动做功。

shots.scene: 手机电池也是同一原理
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a phone battery and a car battery cutaway each showing two halves, ions inside and current outside. No text.
shots.narration: 手机电池也一样：内走离子，外走电流。

shots.scene: 氧化还原分开：两个半电池
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two beakers side by side, the left labeled with an oxidation icon and the right with a reduction icon. No text.
shots.narration: 把氧化和还原分开，成两个半电池。

shots.scene: 锌失电子，铜离子得电子
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a zinc strip releasing ions into solution and copper metal depositing on a copper strip, electrons moving through a wire. No text.
shots.narration: 锌失电子变锌离子，铜离子得电子析出铜。

shots.scene: 盐桥传递离子，平衡电荷
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a salt bridge connecting the two beakers with ions moving through it to keep both sides neutral. No text.
shots.narration: 盐桥传离子，防止两边电荷堆积。

shots.scene: 先看标签：铜盐镍盐有毒致敏
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: bottles of blue and green metal salt solutions with health hazard and exclamation pictograms, gloves and safety goggles. No text.
shots.narration: 铜盐、镍盐有毒，镍盐还可能致敏。

shots.scene: 砂纸打磨电极，当心边缘
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a metal strip polished with fine sandpaper, a sharp edge warning icon, metal dust collected on paper. No text.
shots.narration: 砂纸打磨电极，边缘锋利当心割手。

shots.scene: 锌片配锌盐，铜片配铜盐
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a zinc strip placed in a zinc salt beaker and a copper strip in a copper salt beaker, a swapped pair crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 锌配硫酸锌，铜配硫酸铜，不能放错。

shots.scene: 【实拍】滤纸条浸盐溶液，搭在两杯间
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a folded filter paper strip soaked in clear salt solution draped between two beakers so each end dips into the liquid.
shots.narration: 滤纸条浸透盐溶液，两头浸入两杯。

shots.scene: 盐桥用硝酸钾或氯化钾
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a U-tube salt bridge filled with an inert salt checked, and a salt that reacts with copper ions crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 也可用U形管，盐选不反应的。

shots.scene: 电表先选直流电压档
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a generic multimeter dial turned to a low direct current voltage range, no logos. No text.
shots.narration: 电压表先选好直流电压档。

shots.scene: 夹子夹电极上端，不泡液里
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: alligator clips attached to the dry upper ends of the two metal strips, a clip dipped in the liquid crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 夹子夹在电极上端，别泡进溶液。

shots.scene: 读数约一伏
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the meter showing a reading of about one volt, a small bulb icon glowing. No text.
shots.narration: 马上有读数，约一伏。

shots.scene: 电动势=阴极电位−阳极电位
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a table of standard potentials, a subtraction of the two values giving a theoretical value compared with the measured value. No text.
shots.narration: 查标准电位，阴极减阳极算理论值。

shots.scene: 看两边浓度比值
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two beakers with concentration bars, both halved giving the same voltage, only one changed giving a different voltage. No text.
shots.narration: 浓度也影响电压，关键看两边比值。

shots.scene: 换镍电极，组成多种电池
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three half cells connected in pairs making three cells, four half cells making six cells, a counting icon. No text.
shots.narration: 三个半电池组三种，四个组六种。

shots.scene: 重金属盐溶液进专用废液桶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: blue metal salt solution poured into a labeled heavy metal waste container, a sink crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 铜盐、镍盐废液进专用桶，不倒水槽。

shots.scene: 电极洗净回收，废滤纸按危废，洗手
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: rinsed metal strips returned to a tray, a used salt bridge paper put into a solid waste bag, then hands washed at a sink. No text.
shots.narration: 电极洗净，废盐桥按危废，洗手离开。

shots.scene: 缓冲液：pKa近目标，测着调
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a buffer bottle, a pH scale window and a dropper with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 缓冲液：选近目标的pKa，边测边调。

shots.scene: pH计：校准、冲洗吸干、保存液
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a calibration icon, a rinse icon and an electrode in a storage bottle, all checked. No text.
shots.narration: pH计：先校准，冲洗吸干，泡保存液。

shots.scene: 原电池：盐桥、电表、重金属废液
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two half cells with a salt bridge and a meter, then a heavy metal waste container. No text.
shots.narration: 原电池：盐桥连通，废液按危废收集。

shots.scene: 欣欣手拿一只比色皿
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a small square cuvette by its frosted sides beside a benchtop spectrophotometer, waving goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：分光光度法与水质测定。
